task_description: Build an HTTP authentication service with endpoints to register a user, sign in with an email address and password, refresh an authenticated session, access a protected profile endpoint, and sign out. Store passwords securely, issue short-lived access credentials and rotating refresh credentials, reject reused or revoked refresh credentials, validate request bodies, and return consistent JSON error responses. Use an in-memory user and session store so the implementation can be understood without an external database.

Build a Node.js service that manages a catalog of books in a relational database. Provide operations to create, retrieve, update, delete, and list books with pagination and optional filtering by author. Include database connection pooling, schema migration configuration, parameterized queries, transaction handling for updating a book and recording an audit entry atomically, input validation, and consistent JSON error responses.

Build an HTTP service that accepts a multipart upload containing one CSV file of customer records, validates the file size and expected headers, streams the rows without loading the entire file into memory, normalizes valid records, and writes them to a JSON Lines output file. Return a summary containing accepted and rejected row counts, provide a downloadable rejection report with row-level validation messages, and safely clean up temporary files after processing.

Build a versioned REST API for managing support tickets. Provide endpoints to create a ticket, retrieve one ticket, list tickets with pagination and status filtering, update ticket status, add comments, and delete a ticket. Use an in-memory data store, validate path parameters and request bodies, implement centralized error handling, return appropriate HTTP status codes, and generate interactive API documentation from an API schema.

Build a service for storing and retrieving encrypted application secrets. Encrypt each secret value with authenticated encryption using a server key supplied through an environment variable, use a unique random nonce for every encryption, store only encrypted records in an in-memory repository, and expose endpoints to create, retrieve, rotate, and delete secrets. Add request validation, authenticated access, rate limiting, security-related HTTP headers, and error responses that do not disclose sensitive values or cryptographic details.

Build an HTTP service that returns product details from a simulated asynchronous upstream data source. Add a bounded cache with configurable time-to-live values, prevent duplicate upstream requests when concurrent cache misses request the same product, support explicit cache invalidation, and expose cache health statistics. Produce structured request and application logs with correlation IDs, log levels, durations, cache outcomes, and redaction of authorization headers, while returning consistent JSON errors.
